page_title: LAZ 3-2 ATA | Lazio v Atalanta 08/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' Luis Muriel (Atalanta) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall.
90+3' Adam Marusic (Lazio) is penalised for holding. Daniele Orsato signals a set piece. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Atalanta.
90+2' Luis Muriel (Atalanta) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Luis Muriel (Atalanta) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the right side of the goal. His effort is blocked by Ivan Provedel with a brilliant diving save!
88' A dangerous towering header by Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
88' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) prepares to take a corner kick.
85' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Maurizio Sarri, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!
84' Matias Vecino (Lazio) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniele Orsato had an easy-decision to make.
83' 3 - 2 GOAL! Taty Castellanos meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Matias Vecino (Lazio) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 3:2.
81' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a change. Emil Holm (Atalanta) replaces Matteo Ruggeri.
81' Substitution. Mitchel Bakker (Atalanta) in, Davide Zappacosta out.
81' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) takes a shot from the free kick on the edge of the box and the ball sails inches wide of the right post. What a chance!
79' It's like he was asking for a caution. Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) receives a yellow card.
79' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
78' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Lazio force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
77' Maurizio Sarri decides to make a substitution. Felipe Anderson will be replaced by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio).
77' Substitution. Nicolo Rovella walks off the pitch and Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) comes on as a substitute.
76' Pedro (Lazio) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post.
74' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Juan Musso is prepared to thwart his effort.
73' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Lazio was in an offside position.
71' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) is penalised for a foul. Daniele Orsato had a clear view and blows his whistle.
70' The referee allows time for a substitution. Charles De Ketelaere will be replaced by Luis Muriel (Atalanta).
68' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Taty Castellanos, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
67' The linesman raises his flag. Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) is adjudged offside.
66' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) will deliver the corner kick.
65' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Lazio have been awarded a corner kick.
64' We are about to witness a subsitution. Daichi Kamada (Lazio) for Matteo Guendouzi.

63' 2 - 2 It's a goal! Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) bravely launches himself at a cross from Teun Koopmeiners and gives Ivan Provedel no chance with a close-range bullet header into the left of the goal. 2:2.
63' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) takes a short corner kick.
63' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball goes out of play. Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
62' Good defending. Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) tries to find Teun Koopmeiners inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
61' A pass from Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is intercepted by Ivan Provedel and the move breaks down.
60' Substitution. Gianluca Scamacca makes his way off the pitch and Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) comes on as his replacement.
59' Pedro (Lazio) has a goal ruled out for offside!
56' Maurizio Sarri has decided to substitute Mattia Zaccagni and he is replaced by Pedro (Lazio).
56' The manager makes a subsitution with Matias Vecino (Lazio) coming on for Luis Alberto.
54' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
54' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atalanta.
51' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Ivan Provedel, who smothers the ball.
51' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta).

50' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. It will be a corner kick for Atalanta.

49' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) produced a promising shot towards the right side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Ivan Provedel thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
48' A clumsy foul by Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) and Daniele Orsato blows his whistle.
46' Gian Piero Gasperini makes a half-time substitution. Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) comes on in place of Mario Pasalic.
46' The whistle blows and Daniele Orsato starts the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Ederson (Atalanta) sends a long cross over to Mario Pasalic, but Ivan Provedel comes forward to gather the ball.
45+1' Luis Alberto (Lazio) swings in a cross from the corner, but Juan Musso reads it well and gathers the ball.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
42' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar.

40' Charles De Ketelaere passes to Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta), but he produces a wild shot from the edge of the box which goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.

39' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. A rebound sits up nicely for Nicolo Rovella (Lazio), whose shot from distance is blocked by a defender.

37' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
36' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
36' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
34' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 6:2. The shots on goal statistics – 2:1.
33' 2 - 1 Goal! Matteo Ruggeri gets to the by-line and sends in a lofted ball. Ederson (Atalanta) climbs highest and powers a close-range header inside the right post. 2:1.
31' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
30' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
28' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ivan Provedel intercepts the ball.
28' Referee Daniele Orsato sees the trip by Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Atalanta are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
26' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) brings down the pass, looks up and shoots from distance, but it's straight at a defender who unwittingly blocks it.
25' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the right post.
24' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) passes the ball onto Davide Zappacosta, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
21' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) picks up a pass, nutmegs an opponent and goes for glory with an effort from distance. It's a poor effort, however, and goes well wide of the left post.
21' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
21' Poor challenge! Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) is penalised for tripping and Daniele Orsato blows his whistle. Lazio earn a free kick.
18' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort smashes against the crossbar! What an opportunity!

18' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The ball is out of play. Lazio will have a throw-in.

14' Luis Alberto (Lazio) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall. Nicolo Casale (Lazio) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the right-hand post. However, he couldn't beat Juan Musso, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
14' Daniele Orsato blows his whistle and signals a foul after Ederson (Atalanta) brought his opponent down. Lazio are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
11' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Felipe Anderson plays it into the box, and Taty Castellanos (Lazio) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 2:0.
11' Ederson (Atalanta) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
10' Ederson (Atalanta) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
9' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
9' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Atalanta will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

5' 1 - 0 This is really unlucky! Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) attempted to clear the ball away after the opposition’s corner kick into the box, but instead miskicked the clearance and put it into his own net, specifically inside the left post. He won't enjoy watching the highlights later.
5' Luis Alberto (Lazio) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

5' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Lazio have been awarded a corner kick.
3' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) tries to find Mattia Zaccagni, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Atalanta will have the kick-off.
Daniele Orsato will supervise the game today.
